name: What are the advantages of installing marble in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of installing marble in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marble offers a timeless and luxurious aesthetic that can significantly enhance a bathroom's value. It is a durable natural stone, resistant to heat, and when properly sealed, it can withstand moisture and daily use. Each slab of marble is unique, providing distinct veining and patterns. Its cool surface is also appealing in warmer climates. Regular sealing and appropriate cleaning are essential to maintain its beauty and performance over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Marble adds luxury, durability, and unique aesthetics to a bathroom. It is heat-resistant and, with proper sealing, suitable for wet environments.
